title: CAISO, PG&E Spar Over ‘Large Loads’ Definition

meta.summary:
CAISO and Pacific Gas and Electric representatives butted heads at a meeting over the ISO’s proposed "large load" definition as artificial intelligence data centers pound at the door of the Golden State’s grid. 
 The post  CAISO, PG&E Spar Over ‘Large Loads’ Definition  appeared first on  RTO Insider .
